communication.title: Communication
communication.description: Digital communication solutions for every channel – internal and external, from VoIP to AI bots.
communication.pageDescription: Professional communication solutions from Astoria Systems: VoIP, company chats, email, video conferencing, CRM, marketing automation, AI bots, and much more.
communication.intro: We live in the age of communication! We provide comprehensive solutions for digital communication – from DSL and VoIP to company chats and email, all the way to AI bots and marketing automation. You have a communication challenge? We have solutions!

detailSections.title: Telephony & Internet
detailSections.description: DSL connectivity and modern VoIP phone systems (Voice over IP) for your business. Flexible number management, call forwarding, and integration with your existing infrastructure.

detailSections.title: Chat & Messaging
detailSections.description: Internal company chats, customer chats for your website and apps, project chats, and customer & partner forums (internal and public). AI bots for automated communication.

detailSections.title: Email & Marketing
detailSections.description: Email clients and servers, mass mailings, social marketing tools, and link trackers. See who responds to your marketing actions and how. Marketing automations like reactivation emails and coupon campaigns.

detailSections.title: Video, Webinars & Learning
detailSections.description: Video meetings, webinar tools, survey tools, and an integrated e-learning platform. Everything for digital knowledge exchange in your organization.

detailSections.title: CRM, Support & Sales
detailSections.description: Integrated CRM system, ticket systems for your customers and support team, appointment booking software, and a complete shop system. Everything connected in one platform.

detailSections.title: Planning & Collaboration
detailSections.description: Planning and staff scheduling tools, task and project management with customer and partner chats, plus collaborative working features. Including a knowledge base (wiki) for your company.

communication.portfolioNote: And much more – including custom or industry-specific solutions. Get in touch!

security.title: IT Security
security.description: Liability protection meets IT security – our all-in-one worry-free package for your business.
security.pageDescription: IT security solutions from Astoria Systems: Liability protection, GDPR-compliant servers, encryption, MFA, secure cloud solutions, and security training.
security.intro: Through our unique concept of combining liability protection with IT security infrastructure, we can offer you a clearly structured all-in-one worry-free package. You focus on your business – we take care of your IT security.

detailSections.title: Liability Protection
detailSections.description: Outsourcing of IT security liability – we take responsibility for your IT security and minimize your business risk through professional coverage.

detailSections.title: Secure Server Solutions
detailSections.description: Encrypted GDPR-compliant server solutions and secure cloud solutions. Your data is stored on certified servers within the EU and fully protected.

detailSections.title: Authentication & Passwords
detailSections.description: Multi-factor authentication and secure password management for your entire organization. Maximum access security across all systems.

detailSections.title: Secure Communication
detailSections.description: Secure email communication and secure telecommunications. Encrypted channels for all internal and external communication.

detailSections.title: Secure Interfaces
detailSections.description: Secure API interfaces and webhook concepts. Secure connection between CRM, web applications, and mobile apps.

detailSections.title: Training & Concepts
detailSections.description: Security training for employees (online) and development of individual security concepts. Secure CRM systems for your organization.

portfolio: Secure CRM, Web & Mobile App Integration
security.portfolioNote: And much more – including custom or industry-specific solutions. Get in touch!

infrastructure.title: Digital Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Custom or industry-specific digital environments that grow with your business – including AI and automation.
infrastructure.pageDescription: Digital infrastructure solutions from Astoria Systems: CRM, accounting with DATEV, HR management, IoT, POS systems, industry solutions, and more.
infrastructure.intro: AI and automation are on everyone's lips – do you want to be part of it? It's no longer about whether to use AI bots, teams, or automations – it's only about how and when. We provide you with a custom or industry-specific digital environment that grows with your business.

detailSections.title: CRM & Sales
detailSections.description: Integrated CRM solution (customer management), website solution, quotation, sales, and invoice management including e-invoicing and dunning processes. Everything in one platform.

detailSections.title: Accounting & Finance
detailSections.description: Integrated accounting solution with DATEV export for your tax advisor and access management for auditors. Integrated POS system for hospitality, retail, and wholesale, plus integrated payment systems.

detailSections.title: HR Management
detailSections.description: Leave and absence management, shift and deployment planning, employee contract management. Digital signatures for truly paperless work.

detailSections.title: Communication & Marketing
detailSections.description: Internal communication platform, external communication from one source, calendar functions with booking system, social media marketing, marketing automation, and event planning with ticket sales.

detailSections.title: Production & Logistics
detailSections.description: IoT solutions for production lines, workshop tools, quality control, warehouse management with automation, barcode management, and dropshipping with Amazon integration.

detailSections.title: Knowledge & Support
detailSections.description: Knowledge base (manuals) internal and external, e-learning platform, customer service and ticket system, plus task and project management.

infrastructure.portfolioNote: And much more – including custom or industry-specific solutions. Get in touch!

development.title: Software & App Development
development.description: Tailored software and app solutions with CRM integration, sensor connectivity, and hardware access.
development.pageDescription: Custom software development from Astoria Systems: Tailored software and apps with CRM integration, sensor connectivity, database solutions, and more.
development.intro: Need a custom software or app solution? No problem! We develop software and app solutions that directly interact with your CRM, access external devices, and use internal sensors such as motion sensors, cameras, or LIDAR.

detailSections.title: CRM Integration
detailSections.description: Software and app solutions that directly interact with your CRM solution. Seamless data exchange and unified customer view across all channels.

detailSections.title: External Devices
detailSections.description: Applications that access and control external devices. Connect hardware and software into a powerful complete solution.

detailSections.title: Sensors & Cameras
detailSections.description: Use internal sensors such as motion sensors, cameras, or LIDAR. We connect the physical with the digital world.

detailSections.title: Database Applications
detailSections.description: Powerful database solutions for large data volumes. Optimized queries, secure storage, and intuitive management interfaces.

detailSections.title: Mobile Apps
detailSections.description: Native and cross-platform apps for iOS and Android. Intuitive user interfaces, offline functionality, and push notifications.

detailSections.title: API Development
detailSections.description: RESTful and GraphQL APIs for connecting your systems. Documented interfaces, versioning, and automated testing.

development.portfolioNote: And much more – including custom or industry-specific solutions. Get in touch!
